requirements: The earlier test failed without printing the actual exception. Run its diagnostic version first and preserve the full nested exception stack, transport, attempted/rejected endpoint counts, server handler-entry counts and logs. Identify whether an application update was actually resent; do not infer replay from a missing exception class alone. Test must pass at the exact head for a passed verdict. If it still fails, report the cause and stop or continue independent read-only proof, but do not weaken assertions or silently patch the source head.

The lockfile was provisionally edited on Windows from the five modules printed in the earlier Linux resolution error; it was not produced by Gradle. In a disposable checkout regenerate :solr:server dependency locks and compare; if the generated result differs, retain the generated patch for implementation and fail/incomplete this exact-head proof. Also run the repository-required dependency/license lock tasks on Linux when applicable and record results and changes.

Test testMixedRouteFailureDoesNotReplayMarkedRejection on the pushed head, then in a disposable copy remove only the outer whole-batch update guard, keeping the inner RouteException/503 marker guard intact, and rerun the identical test/seed. The new test's first route error is a SocketException and the other route is marked, so this mutation exercises the communication-error path. Require an actual fail-before assertion and pass-after; preserve XML, logs and mutation diff. The previous multi-shard mutation left the other 503 guard intact, so its pass did not prove the outer guard unnecessary.

If named focused cases pass and lockfile matches, execute the remaining original gate requirements at this exact head: all prior regression and client/core/Jetty suites, real packaged startup and pre-handler marked 503 evidence, tidy with no changes, and root check -x test. Preserve fresh XML, counts, exits, logs, environment and original-PR fail-before evidence. The focused mixed-error mutation above replaces the nondiscriminating multi-shard mutation from the prior gate. Do not extrapolate the earlier gate's passes to this changed head.

Report passed only if every required proof leg is complete and failures are resolved; otherwise failed or incomplete as appropriate. The trust opt-in depends on the operator controlling all intermediaries, and the candidate does not fix ambiguous in-flight update 503s or all pre-existing communication retry behavior. Publish receipt before release with verified executor-stop evidence.
